package external

import (
	"bytes"
	"math/rand/v2"
	"testing"

	"github.com/2comjie/nova/diff"
	"github.com/2comjie/nova/internal/diffgen/testdata/basic"
	pbBasic "github.com/2comjie/nova/pb/basic"
	pbExternal "github.com/2comjie/nova/pb/external"
	"google.golang.org/protobuf/proto"
	"google.golang.org/protobuf/reflect/protoreflect"
)

func TestFieldNumbers(t *testing.T) {
	fields := new(pbBasic.Model).ProtoReflect().Descriptor().Fields()
	for name, number := range map[protoreflect.Name]protoreflect.FieldNumber{
		"level": 1, "level_update": 1001,
		"scores": 2, "scores_clear": 1002, "scores_set": 2002, "scores_delete": 3002,
		"child": 3, "child_set": 1003, "child_clear": 2003, "child_update": 3003,
		"children": 4, "children_clear": 1004, "children_set": 2004, "children_delete": 3004, "children_update": 4004,
		"order": 5, "order_updated": 1005, "order_update": 2005,
	} {
		if field := fields.ByName(name); field == nil || field.Number() != number {
			t.Fatalf("incorrect field number: %s", name)
		}
	}
	if !fields.ByName("level_update").HasPresence() ||
		fields.ByName("child_set").ContainingOneof() != fields.ByName("child_clear").ContainingOneof() {
		t.Fatal("delta presence or pointer oneof missing")
	}
}

func TestLoadSnapshot(t *testing.T) {
	input := &pbExternal.Model{
		Child:    &pbBasic.Child{Count: 7},
		Children: map[uint64]*pbBasic.Child{1: {Count: 8}, 2: nil},
		Order:    []*pbBasic.Child{{Count: 9}, nil},
		Basic:    &pbBasic.Model{Level: 20, Scores: map[uint64]int32{1: 30}, Child: &pbBasic.Child{Count: 10}},
	}
	value := new(Model)
	writer := diff.NewWriter()
	value.InitLink(writer)
	value.LoadSnapshot(input)
	if writer.Len() != 0 || !proto.Equal(input, value.Snapshot()) {
		t.Fatal("loading must restore full state without patches", value.Snapshot())
	}
	input.Child.Count = 100
	input.Children[1].Count = 200
	input.Order[0].Count = 300
	input.Basic.Scores[1] = 400
	if value.GetChild().GetCount() != 7 || value.Order().GetValue(0).GetCount() != 9 {
		t.Fatal("loaded objects alias protobuf messages")
	}
	child, _ := value.Children().Load(1)
	score, _ := value.GetBasic().Scores().Load(1)
	if child.GetCount() != 8 || score != 30 {
		t.Fatal("loaded maps alias protobuf maps")
	}
	value.GetChild().SetCount(11)
	child.SetCount(12)
	value.Order().GetValue(0).SetCount(13)
	value.GetBasic().GetChild().SetCount(14)
	if writer.Len() != 4 {
		t.Fatalf("loaded links lost changes: %d", writer.Len())
	}
	update := value.Commit()
	if update.GetChildUpdate().GetCountUpdate() != 11 ||
		update.ChildrenUpdate[1].GetCountUpdate() != 12 ||
		!update.OrderUpdated || update.OrderUpdate[0].Count != 13 ||
		update.GetBasicUpdate().GetChildUpdate().GetCountUpdate() != 14 {
		t.Fatal("loaded links produced wrong paths", update)
	}

	// Replacing a baseline detaches only this object's old links.
	oldChild := value.GetChild()
	other := new(basic.Model)
	otherWriter := diff.NewWriter()
	other.InitLink(otherWriter)
	other.SetChild(oldChild)
	otherWriter.Reset()
	oldMapChild, _ := value.Children().Load(1)
	oldSliceChild := value.Order().GetValue(0)
	value.LoadSnapshot(new(pbExternal.Model))
	oldChild.SetCount(21)
	oldMapChild.SetCount(22)
	oldSliceChild.SetCount(23)
	if writer.Len() != 0 || otherWriter.Len() != 1 || !proto.Equal(value.Snapshot(), new(pbExternal.Model)) {
		t.Fatal("baseline replacement retained stale links or detached another parent")
	}
}

func TestScalarAndCollectionLoad(t *testing.T) {
	scalarInput := &pbBasic.Scalars{
		Enabled: true, Name: "test", I: -1, I8: -128, I16: -32768,
		I32: -2147483648, I64: -9223372036854775808,
		U: 1, U8: 255, U16: 65535, U32: 4294967295, U64: 18446744073709551615,
		F32: 1.5, F64: 2.25,
	}
	scalars := new(basic.Scalars)
	scalars.LoadSnapshot(scalarInput)
	if !proto.Equal(scalarInput, scalars.Snapshot()) {
		t.Fatal("scalar load changed values")
	}
	writer := diff.NewWriter()
	scalars.InitLink(writer)
	scalars.SetEnabled(false)
	scalars.SetName("")
	scalars.SetI8(0)
	update := scalars.Commit()
	if update.EnabledUpdate == nil || *update.EnabledUpdate || update.NameUpdate == nil ||
		*update.NameUpdate != "" || update.I8Update == nil || *update.I8Update != 0 {
		t.Fatal("zero updates lost presence", update)
	}
	replica := new(basic.Scalars)
	replica.LoadSnapshot(scalarInput)
	replica.Merge(update)
	if !proto.Equal(scalars.Snapshot(), replica.Snapshot()) {
		t.Fatal("scalar zero updates were not applied")
	}

	input := &pbBasic.Collections{
		Signed: map[int32]int32{-128: -32768}, Unsigned: map[uint32]uint32{65535: 255},
		Flags: map[bool]string{false: "", true: "yes"}, Floats: map[string]float32{"x": 1.5},
		Doubles: []float64{2.25}, Counts: []int64{-9}, Bytes: []uint32{255},
	}
	value := new(basic.Collections)
	value.Runtime = "preserved"
	value.InitLink(writer)
	value.LoadSnapshot(input)
	if writer.Len() != 0 || !proto.Equal(input, value.Snapshot()) || value.Runtime != "preserved" {
		t.Fatal("collection load changed values, runtime fields or writer")
	}
	input.Doubles[0] = 9
	input.Signed[-128] = 1
	signed, _ := value.Signed().Load(-128)
	if value.Doubles().GetValue(0) != 2.25 || signed != -32768 {
		t.Fatal("loaded collections alias input")
	}
	collectionReplica := new(basic.Collections)
	collectionReplica.LoadSnapshot(value.Snapshot())
	value.Signed().Clear()
	value.Signed().Store(-1, 5)
	value.Unsigned().Delete(65535)
	value.Flags().Store(false, "changed")
	value.Floats().Store("x", 9.5)
	value.Doubles().Clear()
	value.Counts().Append(10)
	value.Bytes().SetValue(0, 0)
	collectionUpdate := value.Commit()
	body, err := proto.Marshal(collectionUpdate)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	decoded := new(pbBasic.Collections)
	if err := proto.Unmarshal(body, decoded); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	collectionReplica.Merge(decoded)
	if !proto.Equal(value.Snapshot(), collectionReplica.Snapshot()) {
		t.Fatal("collection delta mismatch", decoded)
	}
	value.LoadSnapshot(new(pbBasic.Collections))
	if !proto.Equal(value.Snapshot(), new(pbBasic.Collections)) || writer.Len() != 0 || value.Runtime != "preserved" {
		t.Fatal("empty baseline did not clear collections or runtime data was lost")
	}
}

func TestDeltaRoundTrip(t *testing.T) {
	random := rand.New(rand.NewPCG(17, 29))
	source := new(basic.Model)
	writer := diff.NewWriter()
	source.InitLink(writer)
	replica := new(basic.Model)
	replica.LoadSnapshot(source.Snapshot())
	var previous *pbBasic.Model
	var previousBytes []byte
	marshal := proto.MarshalOptions{Deterministic: true}
	for frame := 0; frame < 500; frame++ {
		for action := 0; action < 8; action++ {
			key := uint64(random.IntN(4))
			count := int32(random.IntN(20))
			switch random.IntN(18) {
			case 0:
				source.SetLevel(count)
			case 1:
				child := new(basic.Child)
				child.SetCount(count)
				source.SetChild(child)
			case 2:
				source.SetChild(nil)
			case 3:
				if source.GetChild() != nil {
					source.GetChild().SetCount(count)
				}
			case 4:
				source.Scores().Store(key, count)
			case 5:
				source.Scores().Delete(key)
			case 6:
				source.Scores().Clear()
			case 7:
				child := new(basic.Child)
				child.SetCount(count)
				source.Children().Store(key, child)
			case 8:
				source.Children().Delete(key)
			case 9:
				source.Children().Clear()
			case 10:
				if child, exists := source.Children().Load(key); exists {
					child.SetCount(count)
				}
			case 11:
				child := new(basic.Child)
				child.SetCount(count)
				source.Order().Append(child)
			case 12:
				source.Order().Append(nil)
			case 13:
				source.Order().Clear()
			case 14:
				if size := source.Order().Len(); size != 0 {
					source.Order().Delete(random.IntN(size))
				}
			case 15:
				if size := source.Order().Len(); size != 0 {
					source.Order().Move(0, size-1)
				}
			case 16:
				if size := source.Order().Len(); size != 0 {
					if child := source.Order().GetValue(random.IntN(size)); child != nil {
						child.SetCount(count)
					}
				}
			case 17:
				child := new(basic.Child)
				child.SetCount(count)
				source.SetChild(child)
				source.Children().Store(key, child)
				source.Order().Append(child)
				child.SetCount(count + 1)
			}
		}
		if previous != nil {
			body, err := marshal.Marshal(previous)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if !bytes.Equal(body, previousBytes) {
				t.Fatalf("frame %d mutated committed delta", frame)
			}
		}
		update := source.Commit()
		body, err := marshal.Marshal(update)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		decoded := new(pbBasic.Model)
		if err := proto.Unmarshal(body, decoded); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		replica.Merge(decoded)
		if !proto.Equal(source.Snapshot(), replica.Snapshot()) {
			t.Fatalf("frame %d mismatch\nsource: %v\nreplica: %v\nupdate: %v", frame, source.Snapshot(), replica.Snapshot(), decoded)
		}
		if writer.Len() != 0 || proto.Size(source.Commit()) != 0 {
			t.Fatal("commit retained old changes")
		}
		previous, previousBytes = update, body
	}
}
